Status and open items
  • Everything here is on the official PBExpo palette — the retired green accent is now Yellow #E8DB00, and navy, blue and orange match the brand guide. Type is Roboto throughout.
  • Copy corrected 2026-08-25: 7,000 projected attendees (was 8,000+), the largest free aviation trade show (was largest tradeshow for aviation and aerospace), and under one roof (the venue is halls C and D, not one hall). The source briefs were updated too, so a regenerate will not bring the old claims back.
  • C and H are live in the first attendee-registration campaign. Variant G is approved; the rest are for review.
  • Airline ads point at the airline Swapcard form, which is separate from the attendee one. Three audiences, three budgets, never combined.
  • Career Runway sells a $3,500 hiring booth, so those end on Reserve Your Booth rather than Register.
